record.title: Prove workspace and environment capability conformance
record.intent: Pressure-test typed namespaced workspace/environment capabilities against the core lifecycle after the protocol checkpoint.
requirements: Preserve optional payloads; required capabilities must fail closed. Keep deterministic evaluation separate from environment probes and prevent providers from bypassing lifecycle validation.
This is taskctl compatibility work using isolated specimens or fixtures. Operational adoption, copied-tool retirement and consumer integration remain tasks owned by each consumer repository.
acceptance: Reproducible fixtures prove extension authority boundaries, preservation, readiness and causal meaning without requiring a live workspace migration.
Preserve the recorded prerequisite gates; this task does not itself authorize consumer migration, protocol freeze or service implementation.
